_comment: Manual squad-readiness ESTIMATES for what-if analysis. Each value is a 0-1 readiness score TYPED IN BY THE USER, not harvested data. This file intentionally contains NO scraped personal biometric data (WHOOP/Oura/Garmin/Apple Health/etc.). 1.0 = fully fresh/available squad, 0.5 = average, lower = depleted/congested. Edit freely to model scenarios; delete an entry to fall back to the days-rest model.

england.note: user estimate — squad reported near full strength, rotated in qualifying

croatia.note: user estimate — ageing core, heavier domestic-season minutes assumed
